summary: Node RED is a browser-based flow editor designed for wiring together hardware devices, APIs, and online services. It provides a visual interface to connect disparate inputs and outputs without writing traditional code for every integration. This helps you build Internet of Things solutions and automation pipelines.
goodFor: Developers and hobbyists who need to visually prototype and coordinate IoT hardware integrations or API data flows quickly.
watchOut: Managing large collections of interconnected flows can become difficult to debug and maintain over time compared to traditional code bases.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker, ensuring that you configure persistent storage for your flow data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
